blocks.text: The Visayas Business Connect Expo 2026 runs from November 26 to 28 at SMX Convention Center Seaside Cebu in South Road Properties (SRP), Cebu City, bringing together four specialized trade shows on Level 1 of the venue. Organized by Global-Link MP, the expo is among the first major industry events at the facility and gives Cebu businesses direct access to suppliers, buyers, and partners in one place. Four trade shows under one roof The expo brings together four sectors central to Cebu’s daily commerce: printing, packaging, and plastics; transport and logistics; hotel and food service supplies; and beauty, health, and wellness.
